agreement.title: AMENDED AND RESTATED CREDIT AND SECURITY AGREEMENT

financial_covenants.name: Net Leverage Ratio

thresholds.condition: for each Quarterly Reporting Period occurring thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: The Borrower shall not suffer or permit at any time the Net Leverage Ratio, as of the end of any Quarterly Reporting Period, to exceed (i) 5.00 to 1.00

financial_covenants.name: Interest Coverage Ratio

thresholds.condition: for each Quarterly Reporting Period occurring thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: The Borrower shall not suffer or permit at any time the Interest Coverage Ratio, as of the end of any Quarterly Reporting Period, to be less than (i) 1.50 to 1.00

financial_covenants.name: Liquidity

thresholds.condition: as of the last day of each fiscal month from the Eleventh Amendment Effective Date until the Twelfth Amendment Effective Date
as of the last Business Day of each week from the Twelfth Amendment Effective Date to the Thirteenth Amendment Effective Date
as of the last Business Day of each week from July 1, 2026 through and including October 3, 2026
as of the last Business Day of each week from October 4, 2026 and thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: The Borrower shall (i) cause Liquidity to equal or exceed $40,000,000 as of the last day of each fiscal month from the Eleventh Amendment Effective Date until

financial_covenants.name: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA

thresholds.condition: as of the end of each Quarterly Reporting Period thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: The Borrower shall not suffer or permit at any time the Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA, as of the end of any Quarterly Reporting Period

financial_covenants.name: Disbursements

thresholds.condition: as of the last Business Day of each week thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: As of May 1, 2026 and as of the last Business Day of each week thereafter, the Borrower shall not suffer or permit the aggregate amount of disbursements

financial_covenants.name: Draws

thresholds.condition: as of the last Business Day of each week thereafter

financial_covenants.quote: As of May 1, 2026 and as of the last Business Day of each week thereafter, the Borrower shall not at any time suffer or permit the aggregate amount of new Revolving Loans,

schedule.condition: if One Hundred Percent Lender Consent has been obtained

cap_groups.quote: provided , however , that the aggregate amount of cash losses and cash expenses included as addbacks in any determination of Consolidated EBITDA under the foregoing clauses (a)(iv) and (a)(viii) shall not exceed the following amounts for the following periods:

definitions.formula_summary: Consolidated Net Earnings plus addbacks (i)-(ix) minus non-recurring non-cash gains, subject to aggregate caps and agent approval

components.label: Consolidated Net Earnings
components.quote: (a) Consolidated Net Earnings for such period plus, without duplication, the aggregate amounts deducted in determining such Consolidated Net Earnings in respect of (i)

components.label: reasonable non-recurring non-cash and cash losses
components.quote: (iv) reasonable non-recurring non-cash and cash losses not incurred in the ordinary course of business,

components.label: non-cash stock-based compensation
components.quote: (v) non-cash expenses incurred in connection with stock-based compensation,

components.label: non-cash impairment store closures
components.quote: (vi) non-cash impairment expenses relating to store closures or remodeling during such period,

components.label: amortization of fees for Indebtedness
components.quote: (vii) amortization of fees payable in connection with the incurrence of Indebtedness during such period,

components.label: cash restructuring expenses
components.quote: (viii) reasonable cash expenses directly incurred in connection with the Borrower’s restructuring activities, including with respect to severance, store closures and relocation costs, and corresponding professional fees, and

components.label: annualized non-cash cost savings
components.quote: (ix) annualized non-cash savings directly attributable to cost reductions implemented during such period (in each case calculated on a proforma basis for such period

components.label: non-recurring non-cash gains
components.quote: minus (b) to the extent included in Consolidated Net Earnings for such period, non-recurring non-cash gains not incurred in the ordinary course of business;

definitions.quote: “Consolidated EBITDA” means, for any period, as determined on a Consolidated basis, (a) Consolidated Net Earnings for such period plus, without duplication, the aggregate amounts deducted in determining such Consolidated Net Earnings in respect of

definitions.formula_summary: Consolidated EBITDA plus Consolidated Rent Expense

components.label: Consolidated EBITDA
components.quote: (a) Consolidated EBITDA, plus (b) Consolidated Rent Expense.

components.label: Consolidated Rent Expense
components.quote: (a) Consolidated EBITDA, plus (b) Consolidated Rent Expense.

definitions.quote: “Consolidated EBITDAR” means, for any period, as determined on a Consolidated basis, (a) Consolidated EBITDA, plus (b) Consolidated Rent Expense.

definitions.formula_summary: All Indebtedness including short-term, long-term and Subordinated Indebtedness of Borrower on Consolidated basis

components.label: All Indebtedness including short-term, long-term and Subordinated Indebtedness
components.quote: all Indebtedness (including, but not limited to, short-term, long-term and Subordinated Indebtedness, if any) of the Borrower, as determined on a Consolidated basis.

definitions.quote: “Consolidated Funded Indebtedness” means, at any date, all Indebtedness (including, but not limited to, short-term, long-term and Subordinated Indebtedness, if any) of the Borrower, as determined on a Consolidated basis.

definitions.formula_summary: Consolidated EBITDA calculated without giving effect to clause (a)(ix)

components.label: Consolidated EBITDA excluding (a)(ix)
components.quote: the Consolidated EBITDA for such period calculated without giving effect to clause (a)(ix) of the definition of Consolidated EBITDA.

definitions.quote: “Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA” means, for any period, as determined on a Consolidated basis, the Consolidated EBITDA for such period calculated without giving effect to clause (a)(ix)

specified_defaults.description: Failed to comply with Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA requirement as of end of Quarterly Reporting Period ending April 4, 2026, resulting in Event of Default under Section 8.2
